itens.titulo: AMD Slides 3% Ahead of Earnings as PC Worries Linger; Intel Drops 5%, NVIDIA Edges Higher
itens.descricao: AMD Slides 3% Ahead of Earnings as PC Worries Linger; Intel Drops 5%, NVIDIA Edges Higher Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Intel's PC warning dragged AMD down 11%, but AMD's data center revenue was up 107% and accounted for 58% of total sales, cushioning the blow.
- AMD's 45x forward P/E sits above its 35x five-year average, leaving no room for Lisa Su to hedge on data center demand timing.
Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) goes into its Q3 2026 earnings report with the chip group divided over how far a PC warning from Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) could spread.
AMD stock is at $489.03 in afternoon trading, down 3%.
The company is scheduled to report results on November 3 after the market closes.
The fall adds to a steep drop on October 30.
AMD stock fell 11% that day, after Intel said its PC slowdown would last at least through the first half of 2027.
Shares of Intel plunged 29% in the same session.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin pinned at $78k after October losses; Binance resumes withdrawals
itens.descricao: Bitcoin pinned at $78k after October losses; Binance resumes withdrawals Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin edged lower to $77,929.9 by 09:50 ET (14:50 GMT), after losing around 6% in the prior month.

Binance resumes withdrawals; says covered over 90% of stolen $6.3 bln Binance said over the weekend it had resumed withdrawals on several major blockchains after the world's biggest crypto exchange by volume was battered by a $6.3 billion theft of funds.
Binance also said it had covered $6 billion of the stolen funds by using internal money to buy replacement tokens following the hack, which was disclosed late last week.
Binance said it had frozen $3 billion of the stolen assets, and that it would cover all customer losses.
spot bitcoin ETFs saw $643.3 million in net outflows Friday, their largest single-day withdrawal in four months, according to SoSoValue data.
It was the biggest daily outflow since June 25, and the funds finished the week ending Oct.
Spot ether ETFs also lost money, with $155.9 million in net outflows Friday, their biggest since Oct.
